reuse.why: schedule-template delegates the daily case to getNextDate and keeps getDateWithSkippedWeekend for moves, but getUpcomingDates writes its own weekend-filtering loop instead of a shared helper, and recurConfigToRSchedule's daily case is not used for the skip.

duplication.why: The two copied ternaries in schedule-template are folded into getEffectiveDate, yet the 'skipWeekend and daily means skip' decision is still written three times (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getEffectiveDate).

placement.why: The core skip lives in shared getNextDate, but the dispatch between skipping and moving is re-made in server/schedules/app.ts and in a private helper in budget/schedule-template.ts.

scope.why: Only the weekend handling paths, the frequency in the schedule data and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Readable, but magic bounds (lookahead 8, count*7+14) and three separate dispatches make the daily rule easy to change in one place and miss in others.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts filters weekend occurrences itself instead of going through getNextDate or a shared weekend helper

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip condition is restated as skipsWeekendDays (getNextDate), `config.skipWeekend && config.frequency === 'daily'` (getUpcomingDates) and the frequency branch in getEffectiveDate, each with its own weekday filtering.

one_place.where: Rule decided in getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts), getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and getEffectiveDate (server/budget/schedule-template.ts).
